summary: Inside fdev1, the existing package-read credential is supplied to a command by fdev-packages COMMAND [ARGS...], which injects FSGG_PACKAGES_PAT into that command environment. An ordinary shell or previously started agent may not contain this variable; absence there does not establish that the credential is missing. Check the documented wrapper before requesting a new token or changing permissions. The installed wrapper was inspected and its route successfully authenticated a package metadata read on 2026-10-22. It leaves GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN unchanged: callers must explicitly consume FSGG_PACKAGES_PAT. For a gh subprocess that otherwise uses the ordinary repository token, select the package credential in that child environment only. Never print, persist, interpolate into command arguments, or publish the token value. Keep ordinary repository authentication separate. Refresh the effective identity, reported scopes and required resource access at use time; this record does not establish perpetual credential validity, organization-owner status, complete private-package visibility, package absence, or publication authority. A readable known package does not make a separate package404 authoritative absence. The cited handoff supplies the original wrapper contract; current operational receipts stay in restricted custody.
title: Use fdev-packages for the existing package-read credential
